title: Bicycle repair day
passage: Thanks for helping at Saturday’s bike repair day. We want to find out whether people can use the public pump without us, and which parts of the ride they’d choose again. The pump stands outside the library and is available all week. People who tried it knew where it was, but couldn’t tell which opening to use. The directions are on a board at the repair stand. That stand is behind a gate that we only open while volunteers are on duty. Someone suggested moving the pump next to the board. Whatever we change, people should still be able to use it when we’re not here. One quick note about the pump tally: make a separate entry each time it’s used, even if the same rider comes back. Now, about the ride cards. Some riders said they loved the market, but wouldn’t ride down the narrow lane again. The river path takes people to that same market. So, write down the path each person actually rode, and ask them to mark the stretches they would ride again. Don’t ask for one rating for the whole outing.
passageZh: 謝謝大家來幫忙週六的自行車維修活動。我們想知道，大家能不能不靠我們就使用公用打氣筒，以及哪些路段是他們還願意再騎的。打氣筒設在圖書館外面，整週都能使用。試過的人知道它在哪裡，但看不出應該用哪個接孔。操作說明貼在維修站的板子上。維修站位於一扇門後方，只有志工在場服務時才開門。有人提議把打氣筒搬到那塊板子旁邊。不管最後怎麼調整，我們不在時，大家也應該能使用。再提醒一下，打氣筒每用一次就要分開記一筆，即使是同一位騎士回來使用也一樣。接下來說騎乘意見卡。有些人說他們很喜歡市集，卻不願再騎那條窄巷。河濱路線也能到同一個市集。所以要記下每個人實際騎了哪條路，請他們標出願意再騎的路段。不要只請他們為整趟出遊打一個分數。
